status: DRAFT: proposed by the code session, UNSIGNED, not run. Becomes binding only when the owner decisions in PREDECLARATION.md are settled and the coordinator signs the prereg.

split.rule: chronological: every eval day is after every fit day; all seven days are in_sample in research/holdout_registry.json; no spent, unread or reserved session is read

label.calibration: none (ExecConfig defaults; ITCH has no receive stamp)

grid.note: regular session minus 15 minutes at each end; first decision at the start, every stride_s after

model: iap.execution.fill_hazard.FillHazardModel defaults (fitted on the fit days of one symbol at a time)

statistics.family: per-symbol verdict on the pooled eval days
statistics.primary: skill = 1 - Brier(model) / Brier(naive fit-set rate) on the pooled eval days
statistics.inference: none: samples within a second-grid day are serially dependent and G = 3 eval days; per-day skill is reported, no p-value or interval is claimed

decision_rule.supports: pooled skill >= skill_min AND per-day skill > 0 on every eval day AND max |observed - predicted| over reliability bins with n >= 100 <= reliability_gap_max
decision_rule.headline: model_supported_on_all_symbols only if every symbol is 'supports' (K = 3, all-must-pass, so no multiplicity correction)

refuse: prereg unsigned, identity mismatch, runner is the signer, or a signing key in the environment
any day not in_sample in the holdout registry, any fit/eval overlap, any eval day not after every fit day
dataset_version on disk differs from the declared one
abort: a day-symbol has fewer than min_decisions_per_day_symbol decisions or fewer than 1 fill and 1 non-fill in the fit set (symbol reported not_estimable)
available RAM below min_free_ram_gb at start
stop_rules.no_rerun: one run; a parameter change (stride, ttl, split) is a new declaration, never a retry

claims.can_claim: on seven in-sample 2019-2020 ITCH days the fill hazard fitted on 4 days predicts the tape-implied resting-order fill within 1 s better (or not) than the naive rate on 3 later days
cannot_claim: Level 2: no real order or fill exists (decision D4a); the label is the simulator's own queue rule replayed on the tape
agreement of the queue rules with real fills
any 2025-26 result, any holdout result, any profit or alpha

reproducibility.note: no random draws; same inputs give byte-identical JSON
